meta.title: Two bids on two lines: award both lines to B; no approval flow
gaps: Prepare or access the requested closed RFQ with two lines and two vendor bids (A and B); the prepared state has exactly one line and one bid
Allocate both requested lines to Vendor B with quantities 10 and 5
Verify the requested Awarded Vendors counter of 1/2 for two awarded vendors
Fill required proposal fields and submit the proposal while checking the proposal totals of 900 and 300
Verify that no approval flow occurs, one PO is created, and the event moves to History
